description: Read. Match. Shine. A picture-and-word reading game for kids in Lithuanian, English and Spanish, where first-try answers earn tokens a parent can exchange for real pocket money from a hidden budget. A Scriptable app.

install.kept: Players, tokens, budgets and the PIN are kept.
install.firstRun: Open it, add a player, then open 🔒 Parents to create the 4-digit parent PIN.
